name: TDM Berhad
overview: TDM Berhad 今年在种植板块持续披露月度产量，并推进印尼两家种植子公司（PT Rafi Kamajaya Abadi 和 PT Sawit Rezki Abadi）的出售，交易完成期限延长至2026年12月31日。医疗板块方面，公司就Tawau新医院大楼的建设与转租签订协议并满足先决条件，同时就Kemaman的KMI Chukai医疗中心发出意向书。此外，公司修订了向PMINT租赁种植土地的租金。
overview_en: TDM Berhad continued to disclose monthly plantation production figures this year and progressed the disposal of its Indonesian plantation subsidiaries PT Rafi Kamajaya Abadi and PT Sawit Rezki Abadi, with the completion deadline extended to 31 December 2026. In the healthcare segment, the company signed an agreement to build and sub-lease a new hospital block in Tawau and fulfilled the conditions precedent, and issued a letter of intent for the KMI Chukai Medical Centre in Kemaman.

segments.name: 种植
segments.note: 持续披露月度及季度棕油产量，并推进印尼种植子公司的出售，同时修订向PMINT租赁土地的租金。
segments.note_en: Continued to disclose monthly and quarterly palm oil production, progressed the disposal of Indonesian plantation subsidiaries, and revised rental rates for land leased from PMINT.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 公司及一名少数股东拟以1.15亿令吉现金将PT Rafi Kamajaya Abadi和PT Sawit Rezki Abadi全部股权出售给Ikhasas Sawit Sdn Bhd，完成期限进一步延长至2026年12月31日。
actions.text_en: The company and a minority shareholder proposed to dispose of their entire equity interests in PT Rafi Kamajaya Abadi and PT Sawit Rezki Abadi to Ikhasas Sawit Sdn Bhd for an aggregate cash consideration of RM115.00 million, with the completion deadline furthe…

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司Kumpulan Ladang-Ladang Trengganu Sdn Bhd与PMINT签订补充租赁协议，修订Kemaman、Setiu和Hulu Terengganu土地的租金率。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Kumpulan Ladang-Ladang Trengganu Sdn Bhd entered into supplemental lease agreements with PMINT to revise the rental rates for lands in Kemaman, Setiu and Hulu Terengganu.

segments.name: 医疗
segments.note: 推进Tawau新医院大楼的建设与转租项目，并就Kemaman的KMI Chukai医疗中心发出意向书。
segments.note_en: Progressed the build and sub-lease project for the new hospital block in Tawau and issued a letter of intent for the KMI Chukai Medical Centre in Kemaman.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 上述Tawau新医院大楼建设及现有大楼翻新项目的先决条件已全部满足，协议变为无条件。
actions.text_en: All conditions precedent for the Tawau new hospital building and renovation of the existing building were fulfilled, making the agreement unconditional.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 子公司Kumpulan Medic Iman Sdn Bhd向GPQ Sdn Bhd发出意向书，涉及在Kemaman, Terengganu建设和发展KMI Chukai医疗中心。
actions.text_en: Subsidiary Kumpulan Medic Iman Sdn Bhd issued a letter of intent to GPQ Sdn Bhd for the proposed construction and development of KMI Chukai Medical Centre in Kemaman, Terengganu.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司KMI Tawau Medical Centre Sdn Bhd与Tawau Healthcare Sdn Bhd签订协议，在Tawau Sabah建设并转租一栋五层、59张病床的新医院大楼，并对现有医院大楼进行翻新。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary KMI Tawau Medical Centre Sdn Bhd entered into an agreement with Tawau Healthcare Sdn Bhd to build and sub-lease a new five-storey hospital building with 59 beds in Tawau, Sabah, and to renovate the existing hospital building.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 公司拟出售印尼两家种植子公司PT Rafi Kamajaya Abadi和PT Sawit Rezki Abadi的全部股权，交易完成期限延长至2026年12月31日。
model_changes.text_en: The company proposed to dispose of its entire equity interests in two Indonesian plantation subsidiaries, PT Rafi Kamajaya Abadi and PT Sawit Rezki Abadi, with the completion deadline extended to 31 December 2026.
